thread:
Alex W: Heads-up — we need a short design review for the new SDK/API + Console UX changes (routing config panel). Looking for a 45m slot next week. Pre-read will include API spec, console mockups, SDK diffs, and a preliminary rollout plan. Can folks share availability and any must-have agenda items?
Morgan L: Quick clarification — is this the auth + routing flags work or the broader SDK surface?
Alex W: Primarily the routing flags + new model-config UI, but we'll surface SDK changes that affect public APIs.
Tayla R: I can present the Console flows and Figma screens. Prefer Tue/Wed morning PST.
Priya S: I'll present the API changes & compatibility notes. Thu is rough for me.
Jon H: Can we keep it to 30m? Infra team has a recurring overlap midweek.
Alex W: I'd prefer 45 to allow Q&A, but 30 is OK if we pre-surface questions in the doc and focus the meeting on decisions. I'll post the pre-read by EOD Fri.
Morgan L: Please include migration notes + an example curl + a compatibility matrix. That helps engineering reviewers.
Alex W: Will do. Draft pre-read checklist I'm going to attach: `1) API spec link (open diff)
2) Console mocks (Figma link)
3) SDK diff + code snippets
4) Rollout plan + canary metrics + rollback criteria
5) Test plan + perf targets (p95 latency, token cost)`
Priya S: Can someone add 2–3 concrete prompts/use-cases for the evals? We need them to prioritize latency vs. quality tradeoffs.
Tayla R: Good call — @Priya S can you add those to the doc?
Priya S: Yep, I'll add three sample prompts and expected outputs by Friday.
Morgan L: Scheduling — I'm free Tue 10–11am PST, Wed 9–11am PST.
Jon H: Wed is good for infra; I'm free 9:30–10:30 Wed.
Alex W: Looks like consensus around Wed morning. Proposed: Wed 9:30–10:15am PST. @calendar-bot please create event, attach pre-read, set presenters to Tayla + Priya, and add Jon as canary owner.
calendar-bot: Event created — "Design review: SDK/API + Console routing" Wed 9:30 AM PST. Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/s/ux-api-sdk-pre-read. Invitees: Alex W, Morgan L, Tayla R, Priya S, Jon H.
Morgan L: :thumbsup: Added. I'll skim pre-read and add inline comments in the spec.
Alex W: Thanks. Action items before the meeting: everyone add blocking issues to the doc's "open items" section, presenters post 2–3 demo flows, and QA list a minimal canary plan. Aim to freeze public API surface by next Friday.
Tayla R: Noted — pushing Figma link in the doc now.
Priya S: I'll add the prompts and compatibility table by EOD.
Jon H: I'll draft a short canary metric list (error rate, tail latency, token cost delta).
Alex W: Perfect. If anything changes, drop it here. See you Wed.
